messages:
Maya: Heads-up: product wants to start sunsetting v1 client version negotiation next Tue. Need ops plan + console affordances. cc @Sam @Eli :eyes:
Sam: What's the signal set we need? error rates, client counts, quota impact?
Maya: Minimal: 1) `client.version.count` per-tenant, 2) `api.v1.error_rate` (5xx + schema mismatches), 3) `route.pin_fraction` (how many requests pinned to v1). Rollout proposal: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 4 days.
Eli: Token accounting alert: v2 uses different tokenizer, expect instant quota delta. We need mapping table and quota multiplier. Also watch embeddings endpoint mapping.
Jun: Console needs a per-tenant 'compat delta' card showing expected cost delta and a one-click pin to v1 for 24h. Also audit logs for pin/unpin actions.
Maya: Agreed. Alert rules: if tenant v1->v2 error rate increases >0.5% absolute OR p50 latency increases >30ms for 10m, auto-revert for that tenant.
Tara: Instead of straight fallback to v1 (risking semantic mismatch), propose a compat-bridge variant that preserves v1 behavior for problematic models. Policy sketch:
```
{ 'on_error': 'route_to_compat_bridge', 'circuit_breaker': { 'errors': 50, 'window': 60 } }
```
Eli: Compat-bridge will add cost. Telemetry teams: please budget for increased cardinality — client.version + route metrics could multiply time series.
Sam: Probe plan: create 3 shadow cohorts (alpha/beta/gamma). Gradually flip traffic and run traced requests. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% absolute OR regression in embed quality by eval suite >2%. Notify SRE and product.
Maya: Draft rollout schedule in #release-war-room. Console UX — persistent compat badge on tenant overview + ephemeral toast when we nudge them. Show predicted quota delta before flip.
ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: Deployment window reserved Tue 02:00-06:00 UTC for canary. :calendar:
Jun: I'll mock dashboards. Who owns console toggle + audit?
Sam: I'll take console backend + alerting rules.
Tara: I'll pair on runbook and compat-bridge infra.
Maya: Thanks — expect PRs for metrics + dashboard mocks by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
